notes: delonix kube play/generate exist (podman-style, Pod subset, fail-closed allowlist) in bins/delonix/src/cmd/kube.rs. The closed subset for interop (Deployment, Service, ConfigMap, Secret, PersistentVolumeClaim) and 'helm template | delonix kube play' are not proven. Acceptance: a simple Helm chart runs in Mode 2; an unsupported field is refused by name.
'helm template | delonix kube play' not proven. In Mode 1 Helm works through the real Kubernetes; that path is covered by H1.
Envoy as an xDS L7 data plane for HTTPRoute is an ADR decision, not implemented. Envoy appears today only as a Cilium workload, not as an engine component.
Native Ceph provider proven live (RADOS/RBD/CephFS/RGW, ADR-0081). Consuming a Rook-managed cluster as external Ceph through the native provider is not tested.
